getting_started.cmd_description: Detailed paginated guide to configuring Coffeecord

page1.title: Getting Started ({current}/{total}) — Overview
page1.description: Coffeecord is modular: enable only what you need, configure per server, and use `/help` anytime to browse every slash command.

field1.name: Before you configure anything
field1.value:
1. **Bot role** — Drag Coffeecord's role **above** roles it must assign (verified, mute, color roles, level rewards).
2. **Permissions** — Grant **Manage Server** (or Administrator) to staff who will run setup commands.
3. **Channels** — Create `#mod-log`, `#welcome`, and `#verify` if you do not have them yet.

field2.name: Fastest path: setup wizard
field2.value:
Run **`/setup`** for a guided draft covering welcome, leave, logging, automod, reaction roles, and tickets. Nothing is applied until you confirm at the end.
Resume later with **`/setup_resume`** or discard with **`/setup_cancel`**.

field3.name: See what is enabled
field3.value:
**`/modules status`** — lists every module and whether it is on for this server.
**`/modules toggle`** / **`enable`** / **`disable`** — turn features on or off.
**`/modules info`** — description of a single module.

page1.footer: Use ◀ ▶ to move through this guide • Page {current} of {total}

page2.title: Getting Started ({current}/{total}) — Logging
page2.description: Logging gives staff an audit trail in one channel. Set it up early so joins, bans, edits, and automod actions are recorded from day one.

field1.name: Initial setup
field1.value:
**`/logging setup`** — pick the log channel and enable logging.
**`/logging status`** — see the channel, enabled events, and module toggles.

field2.name: Fine-tuning
field2.value:
**`/logging toggle`** — turn individual events on/off (message delete/edit, member join/leave, timeouts, bans, role changes, voice moves, etc.).
**`/logging module`** — enable or disable logging for whole feature areas (messages, moderation, tickets, leveling, …).
**`/logging disable`** — turn off logging entirely for this server.

field3.name: Tips
field3.value:
• Use a **staff-only** text channel; logs can include message content and user IDs.
• Enable **`member_join`** and **`automod`** first — they help catch raids and spam.
• Pair with **`/automod set log`** so automod has its own paper trail.

page3.title: Getting Started ({current}/{total}) — Verification & onboarding
page3.description: Verification gates new members until they complete a check. Auto roles and welcome messages handle what happens after (or when) they join.

field1.name: Verification
field1.value:
**`/verifyconfig`** — choose method, verified role, verify channel, and log channel.
Methods: **Simple Button**, **Keypad Code**, or **Color Buttons**.
The bot posts a persistent **Verify Me** panel in the verify channel.

field2.name: Automatic roles
field2.value:
**`/autorole status`** — view rules.
**`/autorole add`** — interactive rule builder (on join, after first message, etc.).
**`/autorole toggle`** — enable/disable autorole for the server.
**`/autorole test`** — preview which rules apply to you.

field3.name: Welcome & leave messages
field3.value:
**`/welcome config`** — channel, message, embed, sticky welcome.
**`/welcome test`** — preview the welcome message.
**`/leave config`** — goodbye message and optional exit survey.
**`/leave test`** — preview leave behaviour.

page4.title: Getting Started ({current}/{total}) — Moderation
page4.description: Combine Discord permissions, Coffeecord slash commands, and automod for layered protection.

field1.name: Slash moderation
field1.value:
**`/ban`** / **`/unban`** — ban by member or user ID.
**`/mute`** / **`/unmute`** — timeout with duration (minutes/hours).
**`/hardmute`** — strip send permissions via roles.
**`/muterole create`** / **`update`** — configure the mute role.
**`/giverole`** / **`/removerole`** — manual role changes.
**`/purge`** / **`/specific_purge`** — bulk delete messages.

field2.name: Automod
field2.value:
**`/automod overview`** — rules and status.
**`/automod on`** / **`off`** — master switch.
**`/automod preset`** — apply a starter ruleset.
**`/automod toggle rule`** — enable/disable individual rules.
**`/automod set log`** — automod log channel.
**`/automod badword add`** — extend the word filter.

field3.name: Inactive members
field3.value:
**`/inactive info`** — how the feature works.
**`/inactive setup`** — days idle before action, kick vs ban.
**`/inactive bootstrap`** — mark current members active (run once on first enable).
**`/inactive enable`** / **`disable`** — scheduled checks.

page5.title: Getting Started ({current}/{total}) — Roles & self-service
page5.description: Let members pick roles without pinging staff. Color roles and reaction roles are exclusive — only one color/panel role at a time per design.

field1.name: Reaction roles
field1.value:
**`/reactionrole create`** — build a panel (buttons or reactions).
**`/reactionrole list`** / **`delete`** / **`edit`** / **`config`** — manage panels.
Good for game pings, region roles, and notification opt-ins.

field2.name: Color roles
field2.value:
**`/colorrole info`** — read this before setup.
**`/colorrole generate`** — create preset colour roles.
**`/colorrole setup`** — guided panel draft (Discord UI).
**`/colorrole publish`** — post the panel from the draft.
**`/colorrole sync`** — fix colours and role order after manual edits.

field3.name: Sticky notices
field3.value:
**`/sticky_msg create`** — re-post a message at the bottom of a channel when new messages arrive.
**`/sticky_msg list`** / **`remove`** — manage sticky rules.
Useful for rules reminders or support info in busy channels.

page6.title: Getting Started ({current}/{total}) — Engagement
page6.description: Keep the community active with XP, polls, and optional supporter perks.

field1.name: Leveling & XP
field1.value:
**`/level`** — show your (or another user's) rank card.
**`/xp config`** — XP rates, cooldowns, ignored channels (admin).
**`/xpset`** — manually set a user's XP/level.
**`/levelreward add`** — grant roles at level milestones.
**`/levelcard customize`** / **`preset`** — card appearance.

field2.name: Polls & fun
field2.value:
**`/poll`** — timed poll with multiple options.
**`/quests list`** / **`checkin`** — daily quest style engagement (if enabled).
Fun commands (`/8ball`, `/flipcoin`, `/hug`, …) need no setup — see **`/help`**.

field3.name: Ko-fi supporters
field3.value:
**`/kofi link`** — link a Ko-fi email to your Discord account.
**`/kofi status`** / **`claim`** — supporter status.
Server admins: **`/kofi add`** / **`remove`** for manual supporter grants.

page7.title: Getting Started ({current}/{total}) — Tickets & utilities
page7.description: Support workflows and quality-of-life tools for larger servers.

field1.name: Tickets
field1.value:
**`/ticket setup`** — panel channel, category, support role (interactive).
**`/ticket add`** / **`remove`** — users in the current ticket thread.
**`/ticket_export`** / **`ticket_import`** — signed JSON backup/restore.

field2.name: Applications & calls
field2.value:
**`/application setup`** — staff application questions and reviewer role.
**`/application`** — members start an application.
**`/call create`** — temporary voice hub; **`join`**, **`add`**, **`end`** manage it.

field3.name: Translation & slowmode
field3.value:
**`/translate text`** — translate a snippet.
**`/translate settings`** — live translate, language, DM delivery.
**`/adaptive_slowmode`** — auto-adjust slowmode from activity (up to 3 rules).

page8.title: Getting Started ({current}/{total}) — Admin & polish
page8.description: Lock down who can run commands, customize appearance, and know where to get help.

field1.name: Command permissions
field1.value:
**`/command_perms docs`** — how overrides work.
**`/command_perms edit`** — per-server slash permission presets (everyone, manage server, custom combos).
Defaults are sensible; tighten sensitive commands (purge, ban, modules) if needed.

field2.name: Themes & branding
field2.value:
**`/theme list`** / **`set`** / **`preview`** — bot embed colours and style.
**`/theme upload`** — custom JSON theme (size limits apply).
**`/theme responses`** — custom text keys for bot replies.

field3.name: Need more help?
field3.value:
**`/help`** — full command list with search.
**`/about`** — version, uptime, links.
**`/getting_started`** — open this guide again anytime.
Join the **support server** from the welcome message buttons or **`/about`**.

page8.footer: Page {current} of {total} • You are ready to configure Coffeecord ☕

support.title: Support Coffeecord! 💙
support.description:
Click the button below to support us via Ko-fi.

✅ Link your Discord account to Ko-fi and buy us a coffee or membership to support us!

**Perks:**
- `Supporter` role!
- Access to a private channel!
- Early access to new features!
- Play GIFs in your leveling card!
- Unlimited translations!
- Up to 3 encrypted host server backup slots (`/backup`)!

**How to activate your perks:**
1. Click **Support us via Ko-fi** below and complete your donation or membership.
2. Come back to Discord and run `/kofi link email:you@example.com` — use the same email you used on Ko-fi.
3. Your perks activate instantly. Run `/kofi status` to confirm.

Need help? Join the support server: {invite}
